text:
Emmitt Finnie was a seventh-round pick, 201st overall in 2023, and he's now playing 18 and a half minutes a night for the Red Wings and on their first power-play unit since Dylan Larkin was suspended. One Bluesky post called him Detroit's long-awaited No. 1 center, then admitted it was "only the slightest of hyperbole."

There's substance behind the joke. He has seven goals and 11 points in 19 games, and Detroit takes 57% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, almost seven points better than without him. His finishing is close to his chances. The line with Alex DeBrincat and Michael Brandsegg-Nygard has been one of Detroit's best.

Ice time settles faster than scoring, and 19 games is a small sample, but the role looks earned. The Hockey News headline on him: "He's Alert And Sharp." Our range: 18 to 30 goals.
